audience: self-storage operators who track units, leases and daily reports in Tenant Inc

useCases.title: Find units ready to rent at a property
useCases.text: List the properties to find a property id. Then list the units of that property that are available to rent now.

useCases.title: Review a lease and its ledger
useCases.text: Open one lease for its unit, dates and rent. Read its ledger of charges and payments to check for unpaid charges.

useCases.title: List move-outs and tenants
useCases.text: List leases that ended in the last days or in a date range. List the tenants on the leases of one property.

useCases.title: Read the management summary for one day
useCases.text: Read the management summary of a property for one day, with daily, month-to-date and year-to-date figures. Read the deposits taken that day.

useCases.title: Track rental activity and occupancy
useCases.text: Read the move-ins and changes for a property over a date range. Read the occupancy statistics of a property for one day.
